constraints: map must be the IANA name of the character set (or a recognized alias), e.g. "iso-8859-1"/"latin1" or "utf-8"; passing the literal * resets the map to the default character set (UTF-8) instead.
mapInOut selects which transfer direction the map applies to: 0 (or omitted) = export/output map, 1 = import/input map.

Only affects text/DIF/SYLK import-export and text-type SEND PACKET/RECEIVE PACKET/RECEIVE BUFFER transfers; has no effect on SEND RECORD, SEND VARIABLE, RECEIVE RECORD, RECEIVE VARIABLE, or BLOB-type packet transfers.
